summary: Full regression + security remediation verification. 96/96 backend pytest passed. UI verified: receptionist upload+authenticated download (blob) fires a browser download; biller Billing Reports + Export CSV downloads billing_report.csv as authenticated request. All security fixes from review confirmed at the API + UI level.

security_verifications.download_idor_token_in_url_fixed: GET /api/forms/{id}/download with ?auth=<tok> => 401 (query token disabled). Header Bearer => 200 with Content-Type: application/octet-stream, Content-Disposition: attachment, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff. No auth => 401.
security_verifications.upload_content_type_spoofing_fixed: Uploaded .txt with client content_type=text/html is stored as text/plain (server-derived from EXT_CONTENT_TYPES). Download still forces application/octet-stream + nosniff.
security_verifications.csv_export_stale_token_role_fixed: GET /api/reports/billing/export requires header Bearer (query ?auth= => 401). Doctor => 403, Receptionist => 403, Biller/Admin => 200 text/csv.
security_verifications.phishing_client_link_base_fixed: POST /api/forms with malicious link_base=https://evil.attacker.com is accepted (form persists) but link_base is ignored server-side and not echoed back; email link is built from server PUBLIC_BASE_URL.
security_verifications.forms_role_gates: create_form / /forms/upload / /forms/{id}/status / /forms/{id}/download all require FORMS_ROLES (doctor/nurse/psychologist/receptionist/biller) or admin. Unauthenticated => 401 verified on all four.

regression_verified: login all 6 roles incl psych@vpp.com (5 tabs: dashboard/appointments/telehealth/notes/messages)
patients CRUD, appointments create+list with patient_name
notes create (doctor/psychologist), AI /notes/summarize returns real summary, biller/receptionist forbidden on GET/POST notes
invoices create+mark paid, status allowlist enforced (400 on garbage)
Team: admin create user, update tabs, edit name/email/role/password, duplicate email 400, short password 400, cannot demote admin, delete user
forms public flow (/api/public/forms/:token GET + submit + resubmit blocked)
brute-force lockout returns 429 after 5 fails; different account still logs in
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~854 lines — consider splitting routers (auth/patients/forms/reports/team) into modules once past 900 lines for maintainability.

download_form sets media_type=application/octet-stream but also keeps stored content_type in the attachment metadata; UI never trusts stored value for rendering, which is correct. Good defense-in-depth.

PUBLIC_BASE_URL is read from env with '' default — if the env var is missing, generated email links become '/form/<token>' (no host). SMTP is currently unconfigured so this is inert, but recommend logging a warning at startup when PUBLIC_BASE_URL is empty AND SMTP is enabled.
billing_export streams a StringIO buffer; for very large exports consider chunked writing to avoid holding the whole CSV in memory (non-blocking, current scale is fine).
test_credentials: Loaded from /app/memory/test_credentials.md — all 6 seeded roles used.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed patients/forms/users and clean up after themselves.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests now use header-based auth for both /forms/{id}/download and /reports/billing/export (per security fix). backend_test.py contains explicit regression tests that ?auth= query token is rejected (401) on both endpoints. Frontend downloadAttachment() and exportCsv() both use api.get(..., responseType: 'blob') + object URL — verified by browser download events. SMTP intentionally unconfigured (email_sent=false expected).
